tagline.en: Echo-Memory (Block-wise SSM) — an interactive, action-conditioned world model whose memory is carried by a block-wise state-space module.
tagline.zh: Echo-Memory（Block-wise SSM）——一个交互式、动作条件的世界模型，其记忆由分块状态空间模块承载。

en: Echo-Memory Block-wise SSM is an interactive world model in WorldFoundry. From a starting image, plus text and a camera trajectory, it generates video that responds to actions — the kind of controllable rollout used to study memory in world models.

This identity is a fixed recipe built around a block-wise state-space (SSM) memory that processes context in two chunks. It pairs the Echo-Memory checkpoint (CC-BY-4.0) with shared Wan2.1 components (Apache-2.0), assembled through WorldFoundry's native diffusion pipeline with a frozen-context strategy. It takes image, text, camera-trajectory, and video inputs; you don't pick a memory method at runtime — the block-wise SSM behavior is baked in.

In practice you provide the conditioning frame and an action or camera path, and the model rolls the scene forward, re-anchoring on its context after each solver step so the generated world stays consistent.
zh: Echo-Memory Block-wise SSM 是 WorldFoundry 中的交互式世界模型。从一张起始图像，加上文本和相机轨迹，它生成能响应动作的视频——正是用于研究世界模型记忆的那类可控 rollout。

这个模型身份是一套固定配方，围绕分块状态空间（SSM）记忆构建，以两个 chunk 处理上下文。它将 Echo-Memory checkpoint（CC-BY-4.0）与共享的 Wan2.1 组件（Apache-2.0）搭配，通过 WorldFoundry 的原生扩散 pipeline 以冻结上下文策略组装。它接受图像、文本、相机轨迹与视频输入；运行时无需选择记忆方法——分块 SSM 行为已内置。
实际使用时，你提供条件帧和一个动作或相机路径，模型便把场景沿时间推进，每个求解步后重新锚定到其上下文，让生成的世界保持一致。

whenToUse.en: Use it for interactive, action-conditioned world rollouts from a single image, and for studying how a block-wise state-space memory helps a world model retain context over time.
whenToUse.zh: 适合从单张图像做交互式、动作条件的世界 rollout，以及研究分块状态空间记忆如何帮助世界模型随时间保持上下文。

notFor.en: It's a fixed research recipe, not a general text-to-video generator, and the memory behavior isn't user-configurable. It needs both the Echo-Memory and Wan2.1 weights staged locally.
notFor.zh: 它是一套固定的研究配方，而非通用文生视频生成器，记忆行为也不可由用户配置。运行需在本地准备好 Echo-Memory 与 Wan2.1 权重。
